Vesting.methodology: Token allocations with vesting schedules from TGE (December 2021)

genesis-pol.name: Genesis Protocol-Owned Liquidity
genesis-pol.methodology: 10% unlocked at TGE for protocol-owned liquidity

community-treasury.name: Community Treasury
community-treasury.methodology: 45% vested linearly over 3 years from TGE

early-contributors.name: Early Contributors
early-contributors.methodology: 6.75% with 6-month cliff (12.5% unlocks), then linear vesting over remaining 3.5 years

founding-contributors.name: Founding Contributors
founding-contributors.methodology: 21.75% with 6-month cliff (16.67% unlocks), then linear vesting over remaining 2.5 years

early-community-rewards.name: Early Community Rewards
early-community-rewards.methodology: 0.2% distributed to early community members on January 1, 2022

early-investors-advisors.name: Early Investors & Advisors
early-investors-advisors.methodology: 6.3% vested linearly from 6 months to 2.5 years after TGE

future-contributors-advisors.name: Future Contributors & Advisors
future-contributors-advisors.methodology: 10% distributed to DAO via vesting contract for future contributors

Incentives.methodology: Multi-chain reward distributions tracked via ClickHouse event logs

ethereum-rewards.name: Ethereum Rewards
ethereum-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from Silo incentive contracts on Ethereum

arbitrum-rewards.name: Arbitrum Rewards
arbitrum-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from SiloIncentivesController on Arbitrum

arbitrum-hedgey.name: Arbitrum Hedgey Claims
arbitrum-hedgey.methodology: Tracks SILO token claims from Hedgey Finance vesting contracts on Arbitrum

base-rewards.name: Base Rewards
base-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from SiloIncentivesController on Base

optimism-rewards.name: Optimism Rewards
optimism-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from SiloIncentivesController on Optimism
